title: Zhimu-Huangbai herb-pair ameliorates hepatic steatosis in mice by regulating IRE1alpha/XBP1s pathway to inhibit SREBP-1c.
authors: Zhao, Wenjun; Wang, Xiaoying; Nie, Wenlong; Jiang, Min; Zhao, Yuan; Zhang, Tong; Ding, Yue
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药知母-黄柏对非酒精性脂肪肝的改善作用，聚焦IRE1alpha/XBP1s通路与脂代谢，仅涉及分子对接作为辅助手段，核心非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Currently, there is a lack of validated pharmacological interventions for non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), which is characterized by the accumulation of hepatic triglyceride. Zhimu-Huangbai (ZH) herb-pair is a traditional Chinese medicine that regulates glucose and lipid metabolism disorders. However, the precise mechanisms underlying the preventive effects of hepatic triglyceride induced by high-fat diet (HFD) remain elusive. PURPOSE: The study aimed to examine the impact of ZH herb-pair on NAFLD in mice and explore the underlying mechanisms, particularly its effects on endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress and lipid metabolism. METHODS: NAFLD was induced in mice using HFD, and the treated mice were orally administered ZH, metformin (Glucophage) or lovastatin. The lipid metabolism factors, ER stress markers, and the unfolded protein response (UPR) branch factors were measured using immunohistochemistry, western blotting or qRT-PCR. Co-Immunoprecipitation (CoIP) was performed to reveal the connection between SCAP and SREBP-1c. Tunicamycin (TM) and plasmid delivery were used to induce acute ER stress or crease XBP1 gain function models. The main compounds in ZH binding to IRE1alpha protein were studied by molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA). RESULTS: Treatment with ZH significantly ameliorated hepatic steatosis and reduced lipid synthesis process mainly inhibiting the expression of mature active form of SREBP-1c through relieving ER stress. The expression of IRE1alpha and XBP1s was inhibited after treatment with ZH. In addition, ZH improved the fatty liver phenotype caused by XBP1 overexpression via decreasing srebp1c transcription. In vitro experimental results suggested that the main compounds in ZH decreased cellular TG contents. Mechanistically, ZH targeted IRE1alpha and inhibited XBP1s mRNA expression to relieve ER stress and inhibit SREBP-1c production. CONCLUSIONS: ZH herb-pair can protect against NAFLD by reducing the expression of SREBP-1c, in part, via regulating IRE1alpha/XBP1s pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：目前，对于以肝甘油三酯积聚为特征的非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD），缺乏经过验证的药物干预手段。知母-黄柏（ZH）药对是一种调节糖脂代谢紊乱的传统中药。然而，其预防高脂饮食（HFD）诱导的肝甘油三酯积聚的具体机制仍不明确。目的：本研究旨在探讨ZH药对在小鼠NAFLD中的作用，并探索其潜在机制，特别是对内质网（ER）应激和脂质代谢的影响。方法：使用HFD诱导小鼠NAFLD，治疗组小鼠口服给予ZH、二甲双胍（Glucophage）或洛伐他汀。通过免疫组织化学、蛋白质印迹或qRT-PCR检测脂质代谢因子、ER应激标志物及未折叠蛋白反应（UPR）分支因子。采用免疫共沉淀（CoIP）揭示SCAP与SREBP-1c之间的连接。使用衣霉素（TM）和质粒递送诱导急性ER应激或构建XBP1功能获得模型。通过分子对接和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）研究ZH中主要化合物与IRE1alpha蛋白的结合。结果：ZH治疗显著改善肝脂肪变性，并通过缓解ER应激主要抑制成熟活性形式的SREBP-1c表达，从而减少脂质合成过程。ZH治疗后，IRE1alpha和XBP1s的表达受到抑制。此外，ZH通过降低srebp1c转录，改善了XBP1过表达引起的脂肪肝表型。体外实验结果表明，ZH中的主要化合物降低了细胞TG含量。机制上，ZH靶向IRE1alpha并抑制XBP1s mRNA表达，以缓解ER应激并抑制SREBP-1c产生。结论：ZH药对可通过调节IRE1alpha/XBP1s通路部分降低SREBP-1c表达，从而对NAFLD起到保护作用。
